# ReModern Living

> > Modern Italian and European furniture retailer specializing in customizable modular sofas, sofa beds, and designer seating from brands like Calia Italia, Fama Living, and ROM.

ReModern Living offers curated collections of contemporary furniture with emphasis on Italian craftsmanship from Matera and modular design flexibility. The site features made-to-order upholstered furniture with sustainable materials and custom configuration options for residential spaces.

## Key Topics

- Modular sofas and sectionals
- Calia Italia furniture
- Fama Living collections
- ROM Belgium seating
- Sofa beds and convertibles
- Italian furniture design
- Swivel armchairs
- Corner sofas
- Custom upholstered furniture
- Luxury modular furniture
- Made-to-order seating
- Matera craftsmanship
- Sustainable furniture materials
- Designer chairs (Venere, Boheme, Alva)
- European contemporary furniture
